people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Paddan
people.line: The homeland of the patriarchs in Mesopotamia

translations.web: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.
translations.bsb: And Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying: “Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the mountains of the east. ‘Come,’ he said, ‘put a curse on Jacob for me; come and denounce Israel!’
translations.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
translations.asv: And he took up his parable, and said, From Aram hath Balak brought me, The king of Moab from the mountains of the East: Come, curse me Jacob, And come, defy Israel.
